# Project Details
## Project Setup {.tabset}

```{r}
project <- params$project
# print(project)
loadProject(projectFile = params$project)
stat_tests <- getTests()
```

**Project file:** `r params$project`

**Dataset:** `r getData()$dataFile`

**Model:** `r getStructuralModel()`

### Parameter Distributions and Random Effects

```{r, echo = F}
specs <- cbind(getIndividualParameterModel()$distribution,
               1*getIndividualParameterModel()$variability$id) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  set_names(c("Distribution", "IIV")) %>% 
  cbind(1*(getIndividualParameterModel()$covariateModel %>% as.data.frame() %>% t()))  %>% 
  as.data.frame %>% 
  rownames_to_column("parameter") 

table <- specs %>%
  apply(2, gsub, pattern = "1", replacement = "check") %>% 
  apply(2, gsub, pattern = "0", replacement = "") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  gt(rowname_col = "parameter") %>% 
  tab_spanner(label = "Covariates", columns = 4:ncol(specs))# %>% 
# fmt_icon(columns = 3) 

for(k in 3:ncol(specs)){
  table <- table %>% fmt_icon(columns = k, rows = !!sym(names(specs)[k]) == "check")
}

table 
```

# Results

## Population parameter estimates {.tabset}

```{r}
# estimates for population parameters with CV
estimates <- getEstimatedPopulationParameters(coefficientsOfVariation = TRUE, withValuesByGroups = TRUE)
if(class(estimates) == "list"){
  estimates[grepl("Infinity", estimates)] <- Inf
  estimates <- unlist(estimates)
}
estimates <- data.frame(estimate = estimates) %>% rownames_to_column("parameter")

if(!is.null(getEstimatedStandardErrors(withValuesByGroups = TRUE))){
  # Standard errors of estimates
  ses <- getEstimatedStandardErrors(withValuesByGroups = TRUE)[[tasks["standardErrorEstimation", "available"]]]
  # Confidence intervals for parameters
  cis <- getEstimatedConfidenceIntervals(withValuesByGroups = TRUE)[[tasks["standardErrorEstimation", "available"]]]
  
  all_parameters <- Reduce(merge, list(estimates, ses, cis))  
}else{
  all_parameters <- estimates
}

```

### Population parameters
```{r}
all_parameters %>% filter(grepl("_pop", parameter)) %>% 
  mutate(transformed_estimate = signif(ifelse(parameter == "betas_pop", estimate*10^-7, ifelse(parameter == "NPs_pop", estimate*10^5, estimate)), 2)) %>% 
  select(parameter, transformed_estimate, everything()) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, signif, digits = 2) %>% 
  gt()
```

### Treatment Effects
```{r}
tab <- all_parameters %>% filter(grepl("beta_", parameter)) %>% 
  mutate(estimated_fold_change = signif(exp(estimate),2)) 

if(as.character(tasks["standardErrorEstimation", "available"]) != "FALSE"){
  tab <- tab %>% mutate(fc_P2.5 =signif(exp(P2.5),2), fc_P97.5 = signif(exp(P97.5),2))
}

tab %>% 
  select(parameter, estimate, estimated_fold_change, everything()) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, signif, digits = 2) %>% 
  gt()
```

### Population parameters by group
```{r}
all_parameters %>% filter(!(grepl("_pop", parameter) | grepl("beta_", parameter) | parameter %in% c("a", "b") | grepl("omega", parameter))) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, signif, digits = 2) %>% 
  gt()
```

### Standard deviations of random effects
```{r}
tab <- merge(all_parameters %>% filter(grepl("omega", parameter)),
             estimates %>% filter(grepl("CV", parameter)) %>% 
               mutate(parameter = gsub("_CV", "", parameter)) %>% 
               rename(CV = estimate)
) %>% 
  mutate(estimated_fold_change = round(exp(estimate),1)) 

if(as.character(tasks["standardErrorEstimation", "available"]) != "FALSE"){
  tab <- tab %>% mutate(fc_P2.5 =signif(exp(P2.5),2), fc_P97.5 = signif(exp(P97.5),2))
}

tab %>% select(parameter, estimated_fold_change, estimate, CV,  everything())  %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, signif, digits = 2) %>% 
  gt()

```

### Shrinkage
```{r}
var <- getIndividualParameterModel()$variability$id
if(any(!var)){
  shrinkage_df <- data.frame(parameter = names(var[var]))
}else{
  shrinkage <- getEtaShrinkage()
  shrinkage_df <- data.frame(
    parameter = shrinkage$conditionalMean$parameters[getIndividualParameterModel()$variability$id],
    conditionalMean = shrinkage$conditionalMean$shrinkage,
    conditionalMode = shrinkage$conditionalMode$shrinkage,
    conditionalDist = shrinkage$conditionalDist$shrinkage
  )
  
  shrinkage_df %>% gt()
}

```


### Correlation of Estimates
```{r, out.width="100%",out.height="100%", warning=TRUE}
if(!is.null(getCorrelationOfEstimates())){
  getCorrelationOfEstimates()[[tasks["standardErrorEstimation", "available"]]]  %>% 
    as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column("parameter1") %>% 
    pivot_longer(!parameter1, names_to = "parameter2") %>% 
    ggplot(aes(parameter1, parameter2, fill = value)) + 
    geom_tile() + 
    geom_text(data = . %>% filter(value > 0.5 | value < -0.5), aes(label = round(value, 2)), size = 1.7) +
    labs(fill = "correlation", x = "", y = "") + 
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white", limits = c(-1.1,1.1)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}else{
  print("Standard Error Not Estimated")
}
```


## Individual parameter estimates {.tabset}

### Parameter Distributions

Test if the transformed individual parameters are normally distributed with the Shapiro Wilk test
```{r}
if(!is.null(stat_tests[["indivParams"]])){
  stat_tests$indivParams %>% 
    select(parameters, statistic = statistics, `p-value` = p.value) %>% 
    gt(rowname_col = "parameters") %>% 
    tab_options(column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
                stub.font.weight = "bold")
}else{
  cat("all parameters have covariates")
}
```

Test if random effects are correlated using a t-test
```{r}
stat_tests$randomEffectsCorrelation %>% 
  select(-coeff) %>% 
  mutate(value = paste0(signif(statistics, 2), " (", format(signif(p.value,3), scientific = TRUE), ")")) %>% 
  select(eta1, eta2, value) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = eta1) %>%
  apply(2, replace_na, "")  %>% 
  as.data.frame %>% 
  gt(rowname_col = "eta2") %>% 
  tab_options(column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
              stub.font.weight = "bold") %>% 
  tab_stubhead(label = "random effect") %>% 
  tab_spanner(everything(), label = "Random Effect") %>% 
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Numbers in parentheses are p-values from a t-test.",
    locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = everything())
  )
```

### Parameters vs Covariates

Test for correlation of parameters and covariates with a t-test and the wald test (stochastic approximation)
```{r}

if(!is.null(stat_tests$wald)){
  tab <- merge(
    stat_tests$indivParamsCorrelation,
    stat_tests$wald %>% rename(covariate = parameter),
    by = "covariate"
  ) %>% 
    select(parameter, covariate, statistics.x, p.value.x, statistics.y, p.value.y) %>% 
    mutate_if(is.numeric, signif, digits = 3) %>% 
    group_by(parameter) %>% 
    gt(rowname_col = "covariate") %>% 
    tab_spanner(label = "T-Test", columns = ends_with("x")) %>% 
    tab_spanner(label = "Wald Test", columns = ends_with("y")) %>% 
    cols_label(p.value.x = "p-value", p.value.y = "p-value", 
               statistics.x = "statistic", statistics.y = "statistic") %>% 
    tab_options(column_labels.font.weight = "bold") %>% 
    tab_stubhead(label = "Covariate") %>% 
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(20)),
      locations = cells_stub()
    ) %>% 
    tab_style(
      style = list(
        cell_text(weight = "bold", color = "red")
      ),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = p.value.y,
        rows = p.value.y > 0.05
      )
    )
  
}else if(is.null(stat_tests$indivParamsCorrelation)){
  print("no covariates")
}else{
  tab <- stat_tests$indivParamsCorrelation %>% 
    select(parameter, covariate, statistics, p.value) %>% 
    mutate_if(is.numeric, signif, digits = 3) %>% 
    group_by(parameter) %>% 
    gt(rowname_col = "covariate") %>% 
    tab_spanner(label = "T-Test", columns = c("statistics", "p.value")) %>% 
    cols_label(p.value = "p-value", p.value = "p-value") %>% 
    tab_options(column_labels.font.weight = "bold") %>% 
    tab_stubhead(label = "Covariate") %>% 
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(align = "left", indent = px(20)),
      locations = cells_stub()
    )
}

tab

```

Test whether covariates should be added to the model using Pearson's correlation test and/or ANOVA

```{r}
stat_tests$randomEffectsVsCovariatesCorrelation %>% 
  mutate(value = paste0(signif(statistics, 2), " (", format(signif(p.value,3), scientific = TRUE), ")")) %>% 
  select(eta, covariate, value) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = covariate) %>%
  # select(eta, covariate, statistics) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = covariate, values_from = statistics) %>% 
  gt(rowname_col = "eta") %>% 
  tab_options(column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
              stub.font.weight = "bold") %>% 
  tab_stubhead(label = "Random Effect") %>% 
  tab_spanner(everything(), label = "Covariate Correlation") %>% 
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Numbers in parentheses are p-values.",
    locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = everything())
  )
```
